name: Rajarshri Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship.
description: • Creating an interest in learning among SC students. • Making financial assistance available for education. • Increase the quality of SC category students. • Only SC category students can avail this merit wise scholarship.

criteria.label: • There is no income limit for the Scholarship.

evidence.quote: • There is no income limit for the Scholarship.

criteria.label: • Students must be Studying in 11th or 12th.

evidence.quote: • Students must be Studying in 11th or 12th.

criteria.label: • Students should secure 75% and above in 10th.

evidence.quote: • Students should secure 75% and above in 10th.
• Student should be resident of Maharashtra

benefits.text:
• Under this scheme, the SC students who secured 75% or more than 75% marks in the SSC examination and takes admission in the 11th Std. will get scholarship @ Rs. 300 per month for 10 months for two years. I.e. in the 11th and 12th Std.
• This Scholarship will be given in addition to GOI scholarship and Freeship

evidence.quote: • Under this scheme, the SC students who secured 75% or more than 75% marks in the SSC examination and takes admission in the 11th Std. will get scholarship @ Rs. 300 per month for 10 months for two years. I.e. in the 11th and 12th Std.

applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
